comment: Conformance vectors for c4m natural order (SPECIFICATION.md, Natural Sort Algorithm). `sorted` lists names in canonical order; every implementation must sort any permutation of them into exactly this order, and for every i < j, less(sorted[i], sorted[j]) must hold and less(sorted[j], sorted[i]) must not. Digit runs are compared as integers of any length: 20-digit runs overflow a 64-bit parse and 17-digit runs lose precision in a double, which made trees with such names sort differently per implementation, or nondeterministically. Shared verbatim by c4 (Go), c4py and c4ts. Text segments compare as whole segments, so a1 < ab ("a" < "ab") even though '1' and 'b' differ at the same offset; a character-by-character walk gets this backwards.
